name: ollama_resource_controls
description: Verify that the supervised Ollama process carries its OOM priority and keeps an uncapped address space, since an address-space cap breaks CUDA model loads

linux.reason: Host safeguards mutate host state and cannot ship in a desktop bundle.

macos.reason: Host safeguards mutate host state and cannot ship in a desktop bundle.

windows.reason: Host safeguards mutate host state and cannot ship in a desktop bundle.

macos.evidence: The macOS resource-limit provider is not wired into this safeguard yet; the host mechanism is launchd resource policy.

windows.evidence: The Windows resource-limit provider is not wired into this safeguard yet; the host mechanism is Job Object limits.
